Metadata.Name: Emergency Break-Glass Access Grant
Metadata.Description: Fast-track approval for emergency privileged access during an incident. All actions are logged for post-incident review.

Activity.Name: On-Call Security Lead Approval
Activity.Description: On-call security lead approves the emergency access grant within a 24-hour window.

Activity.Name: Grant Time-Limited Access
Activity.Description: Provision a time-limited (8-hour) privileged session with full audit logging enabled.

Activity.Name: Post-Incident Access Review
Activity.Description: Review access logs and revoke the emergency grant once the incident is resolved.
